FSN_CARD_RIN-U21_NORMAL: Apply 1 Weak, Vulnerable, and Frail to ALL enemies. Deal 4 damage to each enemy for each of those Debuffs it actually has.
FSN_CARD_RIN-U21_UP: Apply 2 Weak, Vulnerable, and Frail to ALL enemies. Deal 6 damage to each enemy for each of those Debuffs it actually has.
FSN_CARD_RIN-U22_NORMAL: Whenever an enemy gains Weak, Vulnerable, Frail, or Poison that it did not already have, gain 1 Mana and draw 1 Rin card.
FSN_CARD_RIN-U22_UP: Whenever an enemy gains Weak, Vulnerable, Frail, or Poison that it did not already have, gain 1 Mana and 1 Jewel. Draw 1 Rin card.
FSN_CARD_RIN-U23_NORMAL: Gain 3 Energy and draw 2 Rin cards. Gain 2 less Energy at the start of next shared turn.
FSN_CARD_RIN-U23_UP: Gain 4 Energy and draw 3 Rin cards. Gain 2 less Energy at the start of next shared turn.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R08_NORMAL: Whenever a Rin card successfully resolves after actually spending at least 1 Mana, gain 1 Jewel and draw 1 Rin card.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R08_UP: Whenever a Rin card successfully resolves after actually spending at least 1 Mana, gain 1 Jewel and draw 2 Rin cards.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R09_NORMAL: Deal 20 damage to an enemy, plus 12 for each of Weak, Vulnerable, Frail, and Poison it has. Ignore Block.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R09_UP: Deal 26 damage to an enemy, plus 15 for each of Weak, Vulnerable, Frail, and Poison it has. Ignore Block.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R11_NORMAL: Your Jewel Boost multiplier starts at 1 this combat. After each successful Jewel Boost, double the multiplier for the next boost's direct damage or Block.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R11_UP: Gain 1 Jewel. Your Jewel Boost multiplier starts at 1 this combat. After each successful Jewel Boost, double the multiplier for the next boost's direct damage or Block.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R12_NORMAL: Whenever Rin receives a transferable enemy Debuff, transfer the newly gained status to Archer. On success, gain 3 Mana and 1 Jewel.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R12_UP: Whenever Rin receives a transferable enemy Debuff, transfer the newly gained status to Archer. On success, gain 4 Mana and 2 Jewels.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R13_NORMAL: Spend ALL current Mana and Jewels. Deal 20 + 8 per Mana + 25 per Jewel spent to ALL enemies.
FSN_CARD_RIN-R13_UP: Spend ALL current Mana and Jewels. Deal 35 + 10 per Mana + 30 per Jewel spent to ALL enemies.
FSN_CARD_ARC-C18_NORMAL: Archer gains 6 Block. Draw 1 Archer card.
FSN_CARD_ARC-C18_UP: Archer gains 9 Block. Draw 1 Archer card.
FSN_CARD_ARC-C19_NORMAL: Deal 4 damage to an enemy 3 times, or 4 times if Archer holds a projected Arm.
FSN_CARD_ARC-C19_UP: Deal 5 damage to an enemy 3 times, or 4 times if Archer holds a projected Arm.
FSN_CARD_ARC-C20_NORMAL: Return up to 2 Arms generated this combat from Archer's Exhaust pile to his hand. Gain 1 Mana.
FSN_CARD_ARC-C20_UP: Return up to 3 Arms generated this combat from Archer's Exhaust pile to his hand. Gain 2 Mana.
FSN_CARD_ARC-C21_NORMAL: Archer gains 9 Block. If his current HP is lower than Rin's, gain 1 extra Energy and draw 1 Archer card.
FSN_CARD_ARC-C21_UP: Archer gains 13 Block. If his current HP is lower than Rin's, gain 2 extra Energy and draw 2 Archer cards.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U17_NORMAL: Whenever Archer normally plays and successfully resolves a projected Arm, gain 1 Mana.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U17_UP: Whenever Archer normally plays and successfully resolves a projected Arm, gain 2 Mana.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U18_NORMAL: Whenever Archer normally plays and successfully resolves a projected Arm, randomly generate 1 other Arm type into his hand. It costs 0 Energy this turn.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U18_UP: Whenever Archer normally plays and successfully resolves a projected Arm, randomly generate 2 different other Arm types into his hand. They cost 0 Energy this turn.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U19_NORMAL: Whenever Archer gains Block from his own card, gain 1 Mana and deal 4 damage to the current legal front enemy.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U19_UP: Whenever Archer gains Block from his own card, gain 2 Mana and deal 6 damage to the current legal front enemy.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U20_NORMAL: Apply 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable to an enemy. If it was already Weak before this card, gain 2 Energy.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U20_UP: Apply 3 Weak and 3 Vulnerable to an enemy. If it was already Weak before this card, gain 3 Energy.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U21_NORMAL: Transfer up to 2 transferable Debuffs from Archer to Rin. On success, gain 2 Energy and draw 1 Archer card. If none can be transferred, Archer gains 8 Block.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U21_UP: Transfer up to 3 transferable Debuffs from Archer to Rin. On success, gain 3 Energy and draw 2 Archer cards. If none can be transferred, Archer gains 12 Block.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U22_NORMAL: Rin loses 6 HP. Gain 2 Energy and draw 2 Archer cards.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U22_UP: Rin loses 4 HP. Gain 3 Energy and draw 3 Archer cards.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U23_NORMAL: Choose 1 projected Arm in Archer's hand. Its Energy and Mana costs become 0 this combat. Draw 1 Archer card.
FSN_CARD_ARC-U23_UP: Choose up to 2 projected Arms in Archer's hand. Their Energy and Mana costs become 0 this combat. Draw 2 Archer cards.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R08_NORMAL: Whenever Archer normally plays and successfully resolves a projected Arm, randomly generate 2 other Arm types into his hand. They cost 0 Energy this turn.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R08_UP: Whenever Archer normally plays and successfully resolves a projected Arm, randomly generate 3 other Arm types into his hand. They cost 0 Energy this turn.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R09_NORMAL: Every 3 attack hits by Archer, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 Archer card. Hits accumulate across cards and turns.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R09_UP: Every 2 attack hits by Archer, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 Archer card. Hits accumulate across cards and turns.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R10_NORMAL: Exhaust a projected Arm in Archer's hand. Deal 20 + 10 per Arm successfully used or detonated earlier this combat to ALL enemies.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R10_UP: Exhaust a projected Arm in Archer's hand. Deal 28 + 15 per Arm successfully used or detonated earlier this combat to ALL enemies.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R11_NORMAL: Whenever Archer's own Block fully prevents an enemy attack, blocking at least 1 damage without losing HP, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity this combat.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R11_UP: Whenever Archer's own Block fully prevents an enemy attack, blocking at least 1 damage without losing HP, gain 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity this combat.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R12_NORMAL: Deal 18 + 12 per Arm successfully used or detonated this combat to an enemy. You may spend ALL remaining Mana for 8 extra damage per Mana.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R12_UP: Deal 24 + 16 per Arm successfully used or detonated this combat to an enemy. You may spend ALL remaining Mana for 8 extra damage per Mana.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R13_NORMAL: Whenever Archer successfully plays a card that actually costs 0 Mana, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 Archer card.
FSN_CARD_ARC-R13_UP: Whenever Archer successfully plays a card that actually costs 0 Mana, gain 2 Energy and draw 2 Archer cards.
FSN_RELEASE_FINALE_LINE: Rin and Archer have reached the end of the Spire.
